items.name: Screen
items.draw: the outermost container, in double lines: `╔═╗ ║ ╚═╝`. One per wireframe.
items.note: Double lines mean the outer frame.

items.name: Card
items.draw: any box inside the screen, in single lines: `┌─┐ │ └─┘`
items.note: Single lines mean a nested box. Blank line between stacked cards.

items.name: Heading
items.draw: `SECTION NAME` in capitals, underlined with `═════` for a major section
items.note: Capitals. Underline with a double rule for a major section.

items.name: Divider
items.draw: `─────` across a screen, or `├─────┤` across a card

items.name: Placeholder
items.draw: `[image: description]` inside a card

items.name: Skeleton
items.draw: `xxxxxxxx  xxxxx` for content still loading
items.note: Content that has not arrived yet.

items.name: Annotation
items.draw: `<-- note` beside an element. A design note, not part of the UI.
items.note: Design notes live outside the UI.

items.name: Input
items.draw: `[ value________ ]` on one line, label above
items.note: One line. Label above, value inside.

items.name: Textarea
items.draw: a card several lines tall with a `//` resize grip in the bottom-right
items.note: Taller than an input. The grip tells them apart.

items.name: Search
items.note: A question mark marks it as search.

items.name: Select
items.draw: `[ Choose      v ]`

items.name: Menu
items.draw: a card directly under an open select, `>` marks the highlighted row
items.glyph:
[ All types    v ]
┌────────────────┐
│ All types      │
│ > Income       │
│ Expenses       │
└────────────────┘
items.note: The open state of a select.

items.name: Checkbox
items.draw: `[x]` checked, `[ ]` unchecked

items.name: Radio
items.draw: `(*)` selected, `( )` unselected

items.name: Slider
items.draw: `[----o-------]` with the value beside it

items.name: Required
items.draw: `Name *`

items.name: Field error
items.draw: `(!) message` on the line directly under the field
items.note: Sits under the field it belongs to.

items.name: Primary button
items.draw: `[[ Save ]]`, last in a row

items.name: Button
items.draw: `[ Cancel ]`

items.name: Icon button
items.note: A symbol alone. Name it in a note.

items.name: Disabled
items.draw: `[- Continue -]`, dashes mark it as dimmed
items.note: Say why, in a tooltip or note.

items.name: Alert
items.draw: a full-width card with a status icon: `(!)` warning, `(i)` info, `(ok)` success, `(x)` error

items.name: Toast
items.draw: a small card with an icon, a short message, and `x` to close

items.name: Modal
items.draw: a card inside the screen with a capitalized title, `x`, a divider, body, and actions
items.note: Sits inside the screen it covers.

items.name: Tooltip
items.draw: a small card under its element, with `^` pointing up at it

items.name: Badge
items.draw: `( Paid )` status pill, `(3)` count
items.note: Pill for status, bare number for a count.

items.name: Tag
items.draw: `<Food x>` removable filter

items.name: Avatar
items.draw: `(AN)` initials in a circle

items.name: Tabs
items.draw: `[ Active ]  Other  More`

items.name: Breadcrumb
items.draw: `Home > Cards > Visa`

items.name: Stepper
items.draw: `*-----o-----o` with step names below
items.note: Star is reached, o is still ahead.

items.name: Accordion
items.draw: `v Open` with content below it, `> Closed`

items.name: Link
items.draw: `Label >`

items.name: Table
items.draw: a card with `┬ ┼ ┴` column dividers, header in capitals, `v` or `^` marks the sort
items.note: Sort arrow beside the sorted column.

items.name: Progress
items.note: Three styles. The fill matches the percent.

items.name: Bar chart
items.draw: `Rent Co  ████████████  $1,200`: one `█` per fixed unit, and `▏▎▍▌▋▊▉` add eighths. ASCII fallback: `#`
items.note: State the unit of one █. The partial block is the remainder.

items.name: Column chart
items.draw: `███` columns, one row per fixed unit, a `▁▂▃▄▅▆▇` top for the remainder, `───` baseline, labels below. ASCII fallback: `###`
items.note: State what one row is worth. The partial top is the remainder.

items.name: Line chart
items.draw: `*` points against a `$400 │` axis and a `└────` baseline
items.note: Label the top, middle, and bottom of the axis.

items.name: Sparkline
items.draw: `▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█` from low to high. ASCII fallback: `~` then `_ . - = + * #`

items.name: Stacked bar
items.draw: `[FFFHHHHTO]` with a legend mapping each letter
items.glyph:
[FFFFFFHHHHHHHHTTOOOO]
F Food  H Home  T Trip
items.note: One letter per share. Legend below.

items.name: Heatmap
items.draw: blank, `░ ▒ ▓ █` from light to dark, two characters per cell, with a `Low ░ ▒ ▓ █ High` legend. ASCII fallback: `. : - = + * # % @`
